analysis_steps.goal: Reduce HiCIAO qPDI data to Stokes Q, U and PI

method.value: IRAF pipeline: flat-fielding, stripe, bad-pixel and distortion removal; o-e differences give +Q, +U, -Q, -U; Q=((+Q)-(-Q))/2, U=((+U)-(-U))/2; PI=sqrt(U^2+Q^2)

evidence.quote: a polarized intensity ($PI$) image was constructed as $PI=\sqrt{U^{2}+Q^{2}}$.

method.value: Fit radial profiles of each star in Stokes I, scale to Q and U via photometry, combine halos with max(Ha,Hb), subtract

evidence.quote: the final combined halo would be $H_{c}={\rm max}(H_{a},H_{b})$.

key_parameters.value: Profile fit L=A exp(-r^B/C^2) over 15 to 140 pixels

evidence.quote: the profiles are fit from 15 to 140 pixels to exclude the disturbances from the central Airy disk PSF.
the vectors are generally centrosymmetric rather than aligned in one direction, which demonstrates that the vectors were corrected successfully using this method.

analysis_steps.goal: Polarization vector maps and real-structure identification

method.value: Compute theta_p=0.5 tan^-1(U/Q) on binned data (7 and 3 pixels) and check centrosymmetry to distinguish disk from speckle

evidence.quote: We calculated PAs $\theta_{p}$ using the formula $\theta_{\rm p}=0.5{\rm tan^{-1}}(U/Q)$ with binned data of 7 and 3 pixels for Figures 2(a) and (b), respectively.

validation.value: Centrosymmetry of vectors and SNR from Q and U noise

evidence.quote: The fact that some vectors show centrosymmetric characteristics surrounding the central stars implies the presence of real disk structures.

analysis_steps.goal: Toy model of circumbinary ring edges

method.value: Circular outer edge, inclination 37 deg, PA 277 deg; inner edge fitted by an ellipse with the binary barycenter near one focus

evidence.quote: we attributed the barycenter of the binary to be near one of the foci of the inner edge ellipse.
In this paper, the sizes in AU are calculated by assuming that GG Tau A lies at a distance of 140 pc from the Solar System.

findings_qualitative.value: North arc coincides with the northern CO 6-5 core and may be part of a streamer from the ring.

evidence.quote: The north arc coincides with the position of the northern CO core observed by (cite: Dutrey2014)

claims.hypothesis: Does the inner region of GG Tau A show real disk structure?
claims.experiment: Non-masked H-band polarimetric imaging with halo removal and vector centrosymmetry analysis
claims.result: North arc to the north of Ab (>5 sigma) and a structure around Aa out to 28 AU

evidence.quote: Therefore, this area shows a real structure that may correspond to the north arc reported by (cite: Krist2002).

claims.hypothesis: Is the binary SMA 32 or 62 AU?
claims.experiment: Compare ring and circumstellar disk sizes with the Pelupessy formula and simulations

evidence.quote: the results of the present study indicate that $a_{binary}=62$ AU is more likely than $a_{binary}=32$ AU.

claims.hypothesis: Is the north arc part of a streamer?
claims.experiment: Overlay the Dutrey CO 6-5 and Beck H2 maps
claims.result: The arc coincides with the CO core and lies near the H2 peak
claims.finding: It may be part of a streamer

evidence.quote: suggests that the north arc could be part of a large streamer flowing from the circumbinary ring to sustain the circumstellar disks.

limitations_admitted.value: No PSF reference star, so total intensity and polarization degree images could not be derived.
